description: This file defines a wizard interface for employee sign-in and sign-out in the hr_attendance module, including XML form definitions, logic for sign-in/out actions, and flow control states.

classes.name: wiz_si_so
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing sign-in/sign-out flow

methods.name: _get_empid
methods.description: Retrieves current employee ID and info based on user ID

methods.name: _sign_in
methods.description: Handles employee sign-in process, creating attendance record

methods.name: _sign_out
methods.description: Handles employee sign-out process, creating attendance record

methods.name: _si_check
methods.description: Determines whether to prompt for sign-in or sign-out based on last attendance action

methods.name: _so_check
methods.description: Checks last attendance to decide next sign-in or sign-out step
